name: Runemaster Ley Magician converts Spirit and Intellect into spell power and Spirit into spell hit (#948)
contract: Tooltip 804580: spell damage +$s3% of Spirit and +$s2% of Intellect, spell hit rating +$s1% of Spirit.
Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220): MiscValue 128 = 1 << CR_HIT_SPELL, MiscValueB 4 (Spirit), 6.
Effect 2 is the same aura for MiscValueB 4 (Spirit), 30.
Both aura types are native: Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone and Player::UpdateRating read them.
The audit's premise (spell ID absent from source) does not apply to native aura types.
A +100 Spirit buff therefore adds 30 spell power and 6 spell hit rating; +100 Intellect adds 10 spell power.
Without the passive the same buffs add neither. Regression evidence for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let the character settle
Arcane spell power without the passive
Spell hit rating without the passive
Fixture: +100 Spirit
Control: Spirit alone adds no spell power
Control: Spirit alone adds no spell hit rating
Fixture: +100 Intellect
Control: Intellect alone adds no spell power
Ley Magician passive is active
Spirit-to-spell-hit amount is 6
Intellect-to-spell-power amount is 10
Spirit-to-spell-power amount is 30
Spell power with the passive on base stats
Spell hit rating with the passive on base stats
Reapply +100 Spirit
+100 Spirit adds 30% of itself as spell power
+100 Spirit adds 6% of itself as spell hit rating
Removing the Spirit buff returns spell power to the passive baseline
Reapply +100 Intellect
+100 Intellect adds 10% of itself as spell power
Intellect does not add spell hit rating
